audit.summary: The 320x480 and 300x600 ad units render at correct dimensions with strong visual adherence to the Petit Bateau brand (navy header, cream background, bold Futura headlines, red CTA). However, critical issues prevent approval: (1) the Petit Bateau logo is entirely missing from both formats—a severe brand identity gap; (2) the 320x480 product carousel lacks visible state indication (which product is active?); (3) animation states show no perceptible motion or state change (initial ≈ animated ≈ settled), suggesting no functional animation; (4) 300x600 lacks the -10% secondary discount callout mentioned in the brand vision; (5) product image sourcing and French copy polish need verification. These are blockers for campaign launch.

findings.issue: Petit Bateau logo entirely absent. Brand lockup required at top or integrated into header. Logo is mandatory for brand recognition and legal compliance.
findings.fix_hint: Add Petit Bateau logo (SVG or PNG) to the header region. Position above or alongside 'Les Journées Extraordinaires' headline. Use logoFileUrls[0] from style guide. Ensure logo is 40-50px in height, left-aligned with 12px margin in 320px width context.

findings.issue: Product carousel ('MARINIÈRE CLASSIC' → 'VARIANTE COLORÉE') shows no visible indicator of which product is active. No dots, tabs, or counter visible. Accessibility and UX broken for carousel state.
findings.fix_hint: Add visible carousel indicators (3 dots or similar) below the product image. Highlight the active indicator (red #C8102E). Ensure indicators are keyboard-accessible and announce state in aria-live region. Update indicators as carousel auto-rotates or on user interaction.

findings.issue: No animation detected across initial/animated/settled states. Screenshots are visually identical. Carousel should show motion (fade, slide, or crossfade between products) during 'animated' state.
findings.fix_hint: Implement CSS animation or JS carousel logic: Auto-rotate product images every 3 seconds with fade or slide transition (300-400ms duration, ease-in-out). Ensure animation respects prefers-reduced-motion. Verify animation is visible in 'animated' screenshot (product should change or transition smoothly).

findings.issue: Petit Bateau logo entirely absent from 300x600 format. Header is navy only—no logo mark or wordmark. Critical brand identity gap.
findings.fix_hint: Add Petit Bateau logo to 300x600 header. Position top-center or top-left. Use 50-60px height appropriate to 300px width. Ensure logo is white or light-colored on navy background for visibility.

findings.issue: Brand vision mentions '-10% supplémentaires sur produits remisés' (additional 10% off sale items), but this secondary discount is absent from both ad units. Only -30% is prominently shown. Incomplete promotion messaging.
findings.fix_hint: Add secondary discount callout beneath the -30% badge (300x600) or in fine print: 'Dont -10% supplémentaires sur produits déjà remisés'. Use small Helvetica Neue 10-12px. Alternatively, integrate into CTA tooltip or small 'Conditions' link if space constraints exist.

findings.issue: Product images appear to be placeholder/generic stock images. Verify that product photos match official Petit Bateau product URLs from productPictureUrls. Ensure images are high-resolution (2x/3x density) and properly licensed.
findings.fix_hint: Cross-reference product image URLs with productPictureUrls array from style guide. Replace generic placeholders with official brand product photography. Ensure images are 1200x1440px or higher for crisp display at 2x density. Add alt text: 'Marinière rayée Petit Bateau' and 'T-shirt marinière coloré'.

findings.issue: Three color swatches (red, cream, gray) shown as square outlines lack clear labeling. Which colors represent which product variants? Accessibility issue: color alone does not convey meaning.
findings.fix_hint: Add text labels below or alongside each color swatch: 'Rouge', 'Crème', 'Gris' (or variant names). Ensure sufficient contrast and readable font size (Helvetica Neue 10-12px, weight 400). Consider ARIA labels on swatch elements: role='button' or role='radio' with aria-label='Variante rouge'.

findings.issue: CTA button text 'J'EN PROFITE' (I'm seizing it) may be unclear to some audiences. More standard e-commerce CTAs: 'ACHETER', 'DÉCOUVRIR', 'EN SAVOIR PLUS'. Verify CTA copy aligns with campaign strategy.
findings.fix_hint: Confirm CTA text with brand guidelines. If 'J'EN PROFITE' is on-brand, ensure copy is consistent across all formats. If updating, use 'DÉCOUVRIR', 'ACHETER', or 'AJOUTER AU PANIER' (consistent with Helvetica Neue 600 bold, white text). Maintain 48px minimum touch target height on mobile.

findings.issue: Typography 'Découvrez notre collection d'été' uses dark text on light background—contrast appears borderline (possibly <4.5:1). WCAG AA compliance at risk.
findings.fix_hint: Verify text color contrast ratio against background. If using #2E2E2E (dark gray) on #F4ECDC (cream), test with WebAIM or browser DevTools. Darken text to #112351 (navy) or #000000 if needed. Ensure 4.5:1 minimum for body text (Helvetica Neue 400).

findings.issue: Red promotional banner '-30% SUR LA COLLECTION ÉTÉ' is slightly cut off or compressed visually in narrow 320px format. Text appears to wrap oddly or overlap. Layout fragility.
findings.fix_hint: Test text wrapping and sizing on 320px width. Use max-width constraints and line-height 1.2. Font size should be 12-14px (Futura 500 bold). Ensure text stays within ad bounds with 12-16px padding. Consider abbreviating to '-30%' + separate line 'COLLECTION ÉTÉ' if needed for clarity.

findings.issue: No visible call-to-action or engagement element on color swatches. Are they clickable? Do they update product image or send signal? Missing micro-interaction spec or hover state.
findings.fix_hint: Define swatch interaction: onClick, should each color load a different product image or variant description? Add CSS :hover state (scale 1.1, box-shadow) and :focus-visible (ring-2 ring-offset-2). Provide aria-label and role='radio' or 'button'. Document in app.js: swatch click → update hero image + announce variant name.

audit.regeneration_prompt:
CRITICAL REGENERATION TASK for 320x480 and 300x600 Petit Bateau ad units.

**BLOCKERS (must fix):**
1. ADD PETIT BATEAU LOGO to BOTH formats: Use logoFileUrls[0] (SVG logo). In 320x480: place logo 20-30px height, white, top-left of header or centered in navy header (12px margin). In 300x600: place logo 40-50px height, white, top-center of navy header. Logo must be clickable (href to petit-bateau.fr).
2. IMPLEMENT PRODUCT CAROUSEL in 320x480 with VISIBLE STATE INDICATORS: Add 3 carousel dots below product image (or equivalent). Highlight active dot in red (#C8102E). Auto-rotate product images every 3 seconds with fade or slide animation (300-400ms, ease-in-out). Verify animation is VISUALLY DISTINCT in animated screenshot state. Update indicators as carousel cycles.
3. VERIFY ANIMATION EXECUTION: The animated screenshot must show perceptible motion (product fade/slide or carousel state change). Re-run tests to confirm animation is visible and smooth. Duration 300-400ms, easing ease-in-out.
4. ADD -10% SECONDARY DISCOUNT CALLOUT (300x600): Include small text beneath or near -30% badge: '+ -10% supplémentaires sur articles déjà remisés' using Helvetica Neue 10px gray. Or integrate into fine print below.

**WARNINGS (polish):**
5. VERIFY PRODUCT IMAGES: Replace any placeholder images with official Petit Bateau product URLs from productPictureUrls. Ensure 2x/3x density (1200x1440px+). Add alt text: 'Marinière rayée' / 'T-shirt marinière coloré'.
6. LABEL COLOR SWATCHES (300x600): Add text 'Rouge', 'Crème', 'Gris' beside or below each swatch. Add ARIA labels (role='radio', aria-label='Variante rouge'). Make swatches interactive: onClick updates hero image and announces selection.
7. CONFIRM CTA TEXT: Verify 'J'EN PROFITE' and 'DÉCOUVRIR' align with brand. Ensure 48px touch target, white text, Helvetica Neue 600 bold.
8. TEST CONTRAST: Verify body text (Découvrez...) meets 4.5:1 contrast on #F4ECDC background. Use #112351 navy if needed.
9. REFINE 320x480 LAYOUT: Check text wrapping on '-30% SUR LA COLLECTION ÉTÉ'. Ensure all text is readable at 320px width with proper padding (12-16px). Test on actual mobile device.

**DELIVERABLES:**
- index.html: Both ad-320x480 and ad-300x600 wrappers (id attributes correct), logo SVG/img tags, carousel dots, color swatch elements with full ARIA, secondary discount text.
- styles.css: Logo sizing/positioning, carousel indicator styles (active state red), color swatch hover/focus states, responsive text sizing for 320px width, contrast-compliant colors.
- app.js: Carousel auto-rotation logic (3s interval, fade/slide), dot/indicator updates, swatch click handlers (update hero image + announce), prefers-reduced-motion check.
- Ensure both units remain exactly 320×480 and 300×600 px respectively. Test all states (initial → animated with visible motion → settled).
